titulo.alumno:
«Глаголы движения в рассказе»
Movement verbs in a narrative

intro: Идти/ехать usually describe a journey in one direction; ходить/ездить describe habitual or repeated trips.

piezas.titulo: Идти/ехать usually describe a journey in one direction; ходить/ездить describe habitual or repeated trips.
texto: Идти/ехать usually describe a journey in one direction; ходить/ездить describe habitual or repeated trips.
With prefixes, the journey becomes specific: вошёл, вышел, подошёл, отошёл. The case depends on the preposition.

frases.estudio: Когда мы подходили к музею, начался дождь.
frases.alumno: When we were approaching the museum, it started to rain.

frases.estudio: После работы она зашла в аптеку и вернулась домой.
frases.alumno: After work she stopped at the pharmacy and went back home.

pregunta.texto: Which form describes an approach that was in progress?

opciones.explicacion: Подходили presents the movement as an ongoing background.
This form does not express the relation the question asks about.
Check which word governs the case or the structure.

pregunta.texto: What does this phrase mean? «Когда мы подходили к музею, начался дождь.»

frase.texto: Когда мы подходили к музею, начался дождь.

opciones.texto: When we were approaching the museum, it started to rain.
opciones.explicacion: It corresponds to the first example.

opciones.texto: After work she stopped at the pharmacy and went back home.
opciones.explicacion: That is the translation of the second example.

frase.texto: После работы она зашла в аптеку и вернулась домой

piezas.traduccion: After work she stopped at the pharmacy and went back home.
piezas.explicacion: Pay attention to the order of the words and to the grammatical form highlighted.
